skill.summary: Cloud-based for-marketing-video-editing-with tool that handles editing product and brand videos for social media campaigns. Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the cloud-based marketing video editing tool.
- Upload raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB) for quick edits and 1080p MP4 export.
- Handles common marketing tasks: trimming, adding branded text overlays, calls-to-action, and audio tracks.
- Designed for marketers: simple prompts, fast processing (1-2 minutes for most videos), all server-side—no installation required.
- Includes session and credit management, error handling, and tips for best results.
